description: Returns all geo-locations (geoid + human caption + ISO + free-modem count) where proxies are currently available for purchase or migration. Use this to: recommend a location to the user, validate before buy_proxy or change_geo, or filter by country (set country to a 2-letter ISO code). The geoid value is needed for buy_proxy. Cached server-side for 60s and client-side for 5 minutes.

country.description: Filter to a single country by ISO code (RU, US, TR, ...)

name: get_geo_list
title: List available proxy locations
